Workflow.Name: Change Radar handler: Handler template
Workflow.Description: Change Radar handler Handler template: a starting point for your own handler (ADR 0023). Triggers on its own queued handler runs, reads the event, does its work in the Handle scope and marks the run Succeeded or Failed. Ships off, with no subscriptions; copy it rather than editing it. Writes nothing outside Change Radar.
